segments.en: , who has a long history in the field of Artificial Intelligence and, who during the pandemic managed, together with his team from the Complutense University of Madrid, to develop a novel solution in order to evaluate the level of severity of patients suspected of having COVID-19 from their chest x-rays using Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning techniques.

segments.source: Joaquín López Herráiz nos acerca al uso de la IA en el análisis de radiografías de tórax durante la pandemia de COVID-19. Cuenta cómo su equipo de la Universidad Complutense de Madrid desarrolló el proyecto ganador de CodeTheCurve, el hackathon de la UNESCO. La conversación recorre el proceso de desarrollo, sus principales retos y los siguientes pasos que planteaba el equipo.
segments.en: Joaquín López Herráiz discusses the use of AI to analyse chest X-rays during the COVID-19 pandemic. He explains how his team at the Complutense University of Madrid developed the winning project at UNESCO’s CodeTheCurve hackathon. The conversation covers the development process, its main challenges and the team’s proposed next steps.
